A few things we want to validate with an engineer: latency profiling when pinned to local NVMe-backed cache, model quantization tradeoffs, and VPC network policies for private deployments.

Can we schedule a technical demo this week? Our ideal times (PST):
- Tue 11/30 4:00–5:00pm
- Wed 12/1 9:00–10:00am

Attendees: myself (Alex Gomez — Engineering lead) and Priya Shah (Platform).

I attached our sample config and a small run log. Looking for a focused 45–60 minute session with a short agenda:
- Quick overview of our setup (10 min)
- Deep-dive on latency and KV caching (25 min)
- Q&A / next steps (10–25 min)

Thanks — happy to adapt if you have other windows.

Best,
Alex

Engineering Lead, MicroCanvas
